scope: CPU-only CSP3/CSP4 integer reference from existing C2 output; not an RTL-prefix claim

layout.read_address: tile4x4_hwc byte address rounded down to a 16-byte line
layout.hex: one lowercase zero-padded two's-complement value per line

csp3.tail_rule: only y < height is written; physical 4x4 tail padding rows are not expected writes

csp4.tail_rule: only y < height is written; physical 4x4 tail padding rows are not expected writes

pan_dependency_handoff_read_only.note: FusionCSP is reduce PW, split, DW, PW residual, concat; do not invent an out.conv
